History

Newest at the top. The blue one is where you are now. Click any change to go back to just after it — everything after it is undone too. Press ↶ on the right of a change to undo just that one and keep everything you have done since. Changes above the blue one are undone and shown crossed out: click one to bring it back. Making a new change clears the crossed-out ones. This list is kept when you close the window, and goes up to GitHub with the data, so it is the same on every PC, browser and phone.
